_note: Guess the Tamil Movie #4 for Nayanthara's birthday. Clues are objects and places, never faces or the title.

lead.topic: Kolamaavu Kokila (2018): a kolam-powder tin, a hospital bill, a quiet doorstep. Today is Nayanthara's birthday.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kolamaavu_Kokila (Kokila's mother is diagnosed with lung cancer; Kokila is drawn into cocaine smuggling; released 17 Aug 2018)

worth_it.film_people_love: Yes: Nayanthara's dark comedy hit (Rs 73 Cr on a Rs 8 Cr budget, Wikipedia); her birthday is today.
worth_it.clue1_hard_but_fair: A lung X-ray and bills: only fans tie it to Kokila's mother.
worth_it.spoilers: None: only the set-up (her mother's illness, the powder).
